pr.title: Refs #33497 -- Added connection pool support for PostgreSQL.

intent.summary: Add opt-in psycopg>=3 connection pooling to Django's PostgreSQL backend via DATABASES OPTIONS['pool'] (True or a dict of psycopg_pool.ConnectionPool kwargs). One pool per alias is stored on a class-level dict; new connections are configured (timezone, assume_role) by the pool's configure callback, borrowed with getconn() and returned with putconn() on close; pooling rejects CONN_MAX_AGE != 0 and psycopg2; test DB clone/destroy close the pool. The base wrapper now refuses to open a new connection inside an atomic block after the connection was closed. Must not regress non-pooled PostgreSQL or other backends.
